nameEn: Processing and preserving of fish, crustaceans and molluscs
description: This class includes preparation and preservation of fish, crustaceans and molluscs: freezing, deep freezing, drying, cooking, smoking, salting, immersing in brine, canning etc.
includes: preparation and preservation of fish: freezing, deep-freezing, drying, cooking, smoking, salting, immersing in brine, canning etc.
production of fish meal for human consumption or animal feed
production of fish oil and fish meal
production of prepared meals and dishes based on fish, crustaceans and molluscs
activities of vessels engaged in processing and preserving of fish
excludes: processing and preserving of fish on vessels engaged exclusively in fishing, see 0311
manufacture of edible oils from marine material, see 1040
manufacture of frozen fish dishes, see 1075
